subject.title: Feature Request: Session rotation/archive lifecycle event for cron job triggers

question: Should session archive/rotation become a first-class cron-subscription event, or should post-session automation stay on the existing plugin `session_end` lifecycle surface?
rationale: Current main has a real plugin session lifecycle hook but no cron event schedule, and adding one would change Gateway protocol/config plus automatic agent-turn security semantics.

options.title: Define plugin/API lifecycle contract first
options.body: Approve a durable scoped lifecycle event contract and then decide whether cron subscribes directly or plugins dispatch through a narrow API.

options.title: Bless plugin-only session_end
options.body: Document existing plugin `session_end` as the supported integration point and narrow or close core cron-event work if that is sufficient.

options.title: Add cron event schedules
options.body: Add a `schedule.kind: event` shape with session archive/rotation events, idempotency, permission checks, run trace, tests, and docs.

recommendation.title: Define plugin/API lifecycle contract first
recommendation.body: Approve a durable scoped lifecycle event contract and then decide whether cron subscribes directly or plugins dispatch through a narrow API.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans cron configuration, session storage/runtime behavior, and security/product policy, all areas tied to recent steipete history.
